tool_args.rationale: The targeted probe resolves the pilot's threshold ambiguity. Fit all five parameters numerically to the combined observations and submit the resulting law for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient probe shows a pronounced decline and sign reversal consistent with the supercritical term.
There is no coupled-transient-lag signature; the eight available rows cover both sides of the avalanche threshold.
It does not identify the proposed mechanism.
